title: Multicenter Neonatal Eye Disease Screening in China
brief_summary: These exams are vital to protect healthy neonates from blindness. The purpose of this study is to better screen ocular disease in otherwise healthy neonates using wide-field digital imaging system (RetCam III) in a multi-center network in China leaded by Xinhua Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine. The multi-center network will be built with the collaboration of eight hospitals from different parts of China.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Otherwise healthy neonates ( ≥37weeks' gestational age, weighing ≥2500 g, no evidence of systemic disease and an Apgar score of 7 or more.)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Preterm /Neonates with systemic diseases
* Neonates unable to undergo the examination
study_population: Otherwise healthy neonates in a multicenter network in China
